decisions.rationale: Lead Staraptor+Farigiraf gives guaranteed Tailwind via Armor Tail blocking Sneasler/Incineroar Fake Out and Sinistcha Rage Powder + Quick Guard and Sucker Punch, plus Intimidate. Farigiraf Psychic 4x Sneasler, Staraptor Contrary CC/Dual Wingbeat covers Kingambit/Incineroar/Sneasler/Sinistcha. Back Raichu-Mega-Y No Guard Zap Cannon para + Focus Blast 4x Kingambit and SE vs Blastoise, Kingambit Defiant punishes Incineroar Intimidate/Parting Shot and Dark STAB 2x Sinistcha/Delphox with Sucker Punch priority. Bench Sylveon/Arcanine-Hisui - Arcanine 4x weak to Water Spout and Fighting, Sylveon redundant spread when we have better type coverage and wincon with SD Kingambit.
decisions.notebook: Opp 6: Sneasler Sash FakeOut/QuickGuard, Kingambit LO Defiant, Incineroar Sitrus Intimidate PartingShot FakeOut, Blastoise-Mega Modest WaterSpout/DarkPulse/ShellSmash Mega Launcher, Sinistcha Occa TR/RagePowder/MatchaGotcha, Delphox-Mega Timid Levitate HeatWave/Psyshock/NastyPlot. Plan: Armor Tail + Tailwind core to deny priority/redirect, Raichu No Guard vs Blastoise, Kingambit vs Ghost/Psychic, keep both megas flexible game1.

decisions.rationale: Lead Sneasler+Incineroar: double Fake Out + Intimidate controls turn 1, and Sneasler's 189 Speed outruns every non-Mega foe while Close Combat OHKOes their Kingambit (4x) and Arcanine-H (2x) and Poison Jab threatens Sylveon; Quick Guard can also blank their priority (Fake Out/E-Speed/Quick Attack/Sucker Punch). Kingambit in back resists Sylveon's Pixilate Hyper Voice, punishes Intimidate with Defiant, Sucker Punch answers Raichu, and is my slow pivot if Farigiraf gets Trick Room up. Delphox in back is my chosen Mega: at 204 Speed Mega Delphox outruns even Mega Raichu-Y (max 200) and Mega Staraptor (max 178), with Psyshock 2x checking Mega Staraptor (which resists my Kingambit's and Sneasler's STABs) and Heat Wave 2x for their Kingambit.

G1 plan: lead Sneasler+Incineroar, back Kingambit+Delphox; adapt G2 based on which Mega they favor and whether they lead Sylveon/Farigiraf Trick Room.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf Psychic is 109-203% vs Sneasler (4x) but Sash leaves 1 HP; Staraptor Dual Wingbeat 44.9-87.7% guarantees the second hit KOs through Sash regardless of order. Armor Tail blocks both Fake Outs so no flinch risk. Double Sneasler removes Sash threat T1; keep Mega flexible (Staraptor Contrary vs Parting Shot and Raichu No Guard vs Blastoise) so no Mega this turn.

decisions.rationale: Sneasler is dead weight on the field this turn: Farigiraf's Psychic is a guaranteed OHKO through Sash range (170-252%), and any Staraptor follow-up kills it outright. Pivot Sneasler to Delphox, which resists both foes' STABs (0.5x Psychic, 0.5x Close Combat, neutral -1 Dual Wingbeat) and can Mega next turn. Incineroar uses Parting Shot on Farigiraf (safe Contrary-immune target, unlike Staraptor which could Mega and invert the drops) to pivot into Kingambit. Incineroar absorbs any slot-b hit before leaving (it takes only 30-44% from CC, Sitrus heals), so Kingambit never risks the 48-100% possible-OHKO Close Combat. Kingambit enters immune to Psychic, threatens Farigiraf with LO Kowtow Cleave (2x), and at 71 Spe is perfectly positioned if Farigiraf sets Trick Room (slower than Farigiraf's 80-112). Sneasler is preserved at full HP with Focus Sash intact as a late-game answer to their Kingambit (4x CC) and Sylveon (Poison Jab).

decisions.rationale: This is the forced Parting Shot pivot, so the only real choice is Kingambit vs Sneasler. Kingambit is correct: Farigiraf cannot damage it at all (Psychic immunity), and if Farigiraf clicks Trick Room my 71-Spe Kingambit moves before 80+ Farigiraf and threatens a 2x Life Orb Kowtow Cleave, punishing their main mode. The only real threat is Staraptor's CC, which at -1 non-Mega is not a clean KO, and I can Protect to scout a Mega CC while Delphox (resists both their STABs) acts freely. Sneasler is the worse pivot: it is threatened by BOTH actives (Dual Wingbeat 4x kills through Sash as a multi-hit, Psychic pops Sash) and its Fake Out is blanked by Armor Tail. This is also exactly the Parting-Shot-pivot entry my notes prescribe for bringing Kingambit in vs Staraptor, while preserving healthy Sash Sneasler as a late-game cleaner once Farigiraf/Armor Tail is gone.

Staraptor Close Combat into Kingambit is 52-89% (4x) and with Mega Contrary becomes stronger and boosts Def/SpD to survive Delphox Heat Wave (36-53% spread) + Kingambit. Dual Wingbeat cannot KO Delphox alone (20-40% vs 48% HP) and Tailwind gives free damage to Kingambit. Mega Staraptor now commits Contrary boosts while preserving Raichu-Mega-Y for later vs Blastoise.

decisions.rationale: Heat Wave is neutral into BOTH foes (Fire is not resisted by Normal/Psychic): 22.5-41.5% into Farigiraf plus Kingambit's Kowtow (85.9-157.4%) guarantees the Farigiraf KO before it moves (Delphox 171 and Kingambit 71 both act ahead of Farigiraf 80-112), denying Trick Room and Armor Tail. Heat Wave also chips Staraptor 30-62% and stays neutral even if it Mega Evolves (unlike Psyshock, which Mega Staraptor's Fighting typing would resist). Mega Evolving now is free (only stone on my side), boosts both chips, and raises SpD; Delphox survives any single hit from this board and even if it falls, Kingambit trades up into Farigiraf. Kingambit ignores Protect because stalling only lets TR go up while it remains 4x-CC bait; firing Kowtow banks guaranteed value.

decisions.rationale: Kingambit's replacement must be Sneasler. Switching Incineroar in now triggers Intimidate into Mega Staraptor's Contrary, boosting it from -1 to 0 Atk — at 0 Atk its Dual Wingbeat likely KOs 48% Delphox, whereas at -1 Delphox comfortably survives (CC 25.8-36.4%). Sneasler (189) outspeeds Staraptor (143-178), and Delphox Psyshock (43.8-80%) + Sneasler Poison Jab (19.3-34.4%) guarantee the KO from 57% before Staraptor moves; Farigiraf's Armor Tail also nullifies Incineroar's Fake Out anyway. Sneasler additionally answers the likely backline (CC 4x vs Kingambit, 2x vs Arcanine-H, Poison Jab 2x vs Sylveon). Never forfeit a 3v4 with speed control and Sash intact.

decisions.rationale: Staraptor at 57% is in Delphox Psyshock KO range (49.7-69.2%) so must Protect. Farigiraf Psychic is 4x vs Sneasler (70.6-139.4%) and with Sash will leave it at 1 HP on high roll or ~30% on low roll, breaking Sash for next turn since not at full HP. Double targeting Sneasler with Staraptor would guarantee KO but risks losing Staraptor to Psyshock; preserving the 4v3 advantage and Armor Tail is higher EV. reflections.summary: Won 1-0 in 9 turns because preview and piloting aligned. Preview: Farigiraf (Armor Tail Sitrus TR/Psychic/Helping Hand/Protect) + Staraptor-Mega + Raichu + Kingambit correctly covered opp's actual 4 (Delphox-Mega/Sneasler/Incineroar/Kingambit) while leaving Blastoise-Mega/Sinistcha (TR/Rage Powder) unbrought. Mega Staraptor (Contrary) over Mega Raichu-Y (No Guard) was correct for this matchup - Contrary Close Combat OHKO'd LO Kingambit T2 and Dual Wingbeat chipped Delphox 39%, despite leaving Raichu as LightningRod (50% Zap Cannon/70% Focus Blast). Piloting: T2-3 double Protect reads blocked Heat Wave + Psyshock + Poison Jab, Farigiraf Psychic broke Sneasler Sash then KO'd, late T8 Trick Room (4 turns left at end) reversed speed vs Timid Delphox, T7 Helping Hand Focus Blast KO'd Incineroar and T9 Psychic + Zap Cannon KO'd Delphox despite accuracy gamble, overcoming crit Psyshock loss of Staraptor T4 and Kingambit trading poorly into Incineroar Flare Blitz x2.

Don't leave LO Kingambit vs Incineroar Flare Blitz - Protect/pivot instead. Time Trick Room earlier or deny theirs, and consider flipping Mega to Raichu-Y for No Guard guaranteed Zap Cannon/Focus Blast vs Delphox/Incineroar rather than relying on 50%/70% LightningRod rolls that hit this game.

reflections.summary: Preview was mostly right — Delphox-Mega was the correct Mega (Psyshock 2x SE removed Mega Staraptor; 204 Spe outspeeds base Raichu) and Sneasler/Incineroar fit, but Kingambit was a dead slot into this four (4x weak to Staraptor's Close Combat, Sucker Punch blanked by Armor Tail) and was OHKO'd without moving. Piloting had 0 decision errors, yet the resource war was lost: Delphox took 52% switching into Dual Wingbeat plus a resisted Psychic on turn 1, and Incineroar — the intended Trick Room anchor — was spent (with Flare Blitz recoil) removing enemy Kingambit, then died to Helping Hand Focus Blast. That left a half-HP Delphox solo vs Raichu + Farigiraf; they double-Protect-stalled, set Trick Room, and double-targeted it, with base Raichu's 50% Zap Cannon landing the KO. At full HP Delphox survives that exact sequence and KOs Raichu back, so the early chip and losing the anchor — not the final accuracy flip — decided it.
